content.value: An office block with 30 storeys above ground floor having a group of 6 lifts with 15 unified starting and stopping times is to have a floor area above the ground floor of 12000 m²and floor height of 3m. Each car of the lifts has a capacity of 20 persons and a speed of 2.5 M/s. The clear door width is to be 1.1 m and the doors are to open at a speed of 0.4m/s.Estimate the peak demand, interval and quality of service that is to be provided.
